test_interpolate_face_attributes_python: test the python interpolate_face_attributes_python function with barycentric coordinates and face attributes on CUDA
test_interpolate_face_attributes_cuda: test the CUDA interpolate_face_attributes function with pixel-to-face mapping and barycentric coordinates
test_python_vs_cuda_interpolation: test that python and CUDA interpolate_face_attributes produce matching forward and backward gradients
test_interpolate_attributes_with_meshes: test interpolate_face_attributes using Meshes, TexturesVertex, and Fragments to compute interpolated texels
test_interpolate_attributes_gradient_flo: test gradient flow through interpolate_face_attributes by backpropagating through mesh vertex texture features
